summary: Baiya International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor for the issuance of 13,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.312 per share for aggregate proceeds of $4,212,000 on April 29, 2026. This is a routine registered direct or PIPE offering, not a special situation. The filing discloses no board recommendation or advisor. No premium, tender, or structural complexity exists. What to watch: no special-situation angle given the straightforward capital raise.
